id: 04_Hot Work Safety in hindi Hot Work hazards & precautions in hindi HSE STUDY GUIDE
title: 动火作业的危害与预防
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/04_Hot Work Safety in hindi Hot Work hazards & precautions in hindi HSE STUDY GUIDE.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/04_Hot Work Safety in hindi Hot Work hazards & precautions in hindi HSE STUDY GUIDE/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在工作间门口，门旁挂着灭火器标志，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a university workshop next to a fire extinguisher sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲动火作业的危害与预防。
overlay: 动火作业的危害与预防

shots.scene: 火焰、火花、许可单、灭火器四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a flame, flying sparks, a blank permit form and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 有明火、有火花，就要格外小心。

shots.scene: 实验楼走廊里，维修架旁堆着纸箱，老李拿着焊接面罩
shots.prompt_en: In a lab building corridor, cardboard boxes are piled near a repair scaffold, and the facility engineer holds a welding helmet.
shots.narration: 实验楼要焊一段管道支架。

shots.scene: 小研指着纸箱和旁边实验室门上的易燃标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the cardboard boxes and at a flammable warning sign on a nearby lab door.
shots.narration: 小研发现，旁边就是存放溶剂的实验室。

shots.scene: 老李放下面罩，拿出一张空白许可单
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts down the welding helmet and takes out a blank permit form.
shots.narration: 老李说：先清场、先审批，再动火。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们来看看，动火作业该怎么管。

shots.scene: 喷灯火焰和气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a small gas torch flame and a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 使用明火的作业，叫动火作业。

shots.scene: 电焊、切割、打磨三个图标，都冒火花
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each throwing sparks: an arc welding torch, a cutting torch and an angle grinder. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接、切割、打磨会产生火源，也算。

shots.scene: 空白许可单上盖章打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank work permit form receiving a stamp and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 动火之前，必须先办作业许可。

shots.scene: 火花落向纸箱，燃起火焰；气瓶旁有爆炸图标
shots.prompt_en: Sparks fall onto a cardboard box that catches fire, and a burst icon appears beside a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 第一大危害，是火灾和爆炸。

shots.scene: 火花飞溅很远的示意，箭头指向远处
shots.prompt_en: Sparks flying far across the floor with long arrows showing how far they travel. No people.
shots.narration: 火花会飞溅、滚落到很远。

shots.scene: 焊机电缆破皮冒出闪电
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a welding machine with a damaged cable sparking, with an electric shock warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 焊机、砂轮机漏电，会触电。

shots.scene: 焊点上方升起灰色烟雾，旁边肺部图标
shots.prompt_en: Gray fumes rising from a welding point toward a lung icon with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接烟尘有毒，伤呼吸系统。

shots.scene: 刚焊完发红的工件，伸手去摸的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a freshly welded glowing hot metal piece and a bare hand reaching toward it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 刚焊完的工件很烫，别用手摸。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标正对强光，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon staring directly at a bright welding light, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接强光和红外线会伤眼睛。

shots.scene: 焊条与工件之间耀眼的电弧图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bright electric arc between an electrode and a metal plate with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 电弧温度极高，也是危害。

shots.scene: 没有护罩的砂轮碎裂，碎片飞出
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a grinding wheel without a guard cracking apart with fragments flying, red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 砂轮没护罩，碎了就会伤人。

shots.scene: 耳朵和抖动的手两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an ear with loud sound waves and two hands with shaking lines. No people.
shots.narration: 还有噪声和振动。

shots.scene: 老李和小研把纸箱、溶剂桶搬离作业点
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the female graduate student carry cardboard boxes and a closed solvent can away from the work spot.
shots.narration: 预防第一步：移走易燃、可燃物。

shots.scene: 作业点周围一圈空地，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A top view of the work spot surrounded by a clear empty zone, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 作业点周围清干净，不留隐患。

shots.scene: 固定的柜子被防火毯盖住
shots.prompt_en: A fixed wooden cabinet covered with a flame resistant fire blanket. No people.
shots.narration: 搬不走的，用防火毯盖严。

shots.scene: 阿杰清扫地面，拖干积水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sweeps the floor and mops up a puddle near the work spot.
shots.narration: 地面扫干净，不留积水和杂物。

shots.scene: 老李穿戴焊接面罩、皮围裙、长袖皮手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on a welding helmet, a leather apron and long leather gloves.
shots.narration: 作业人员要穿戴全套防护。

shots.scene: 皮护腿、袖套、防尘口罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of leather leg guards, leather sleeves and a filter mask. No people.
shots.narration: 护腿、袖套、防尘口罩，一样不少。

shots.scene: 焊机电源接在带漏电保护器的配电箱上，外壳接地
shots.prompt_en: A welding machine connected to a socket box with a residual current breaker, its case linked to a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 焊机电源要有漏电保护，外壳接地。

shots.scene: 狭小空间入口旁有空白气体检测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: A narrow poorly ventilated space with a blank gas detector icon at its entrance. No people.
shots.narration: 狭窄、通风差的地方，先测气体。

shots.scene: 老李戴焊接面罩，阿杰在旁戴面屏递工具
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a welding helmet while the young male student beside him wears a face shield and hands him a tool.
shots.narration: 焊工戴面罩，旁边的助手也要防护。

shots.scene: 灭火器标志下有灭火器和灭火毯
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher sign above a fire extinguisher and a folded fire blanket next to the work spot. No people.
shots.narration: 现场备好灭火器和灭火毯。

shots.scene: 小研拿着灭火器站在作业点旁看护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands watch near the work spot holding a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 安排专人看火，盯住火花去向。

shots.scene: 作业点四周围上防火挡板
shots.prompt_en: Flame resistant screens set up around the work spot, sparks stopped inside. No people.
shots.narration: 火花要全部挡住，不让飞出。

shots.scene: 带挡帘的焊接隔间
shots.prompt_en: An empty welding booth with flame resistant curtains in a workshop. No people.
shots.narration: 能在焊接隔间做的，就进隔间做。

shots.scene: 砂轮机护罩完好，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An angle grinder with its wheel guard properly in place, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 砂轮机必须装好护罩。

shots.scene: 手松开开关，砂轮停转
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand releasing the switch of a grinder, and the wheel stops. No people.
shots.narration: 开关要松手即停，用前试一试。

shots.scene: 砂轮片和机器标签比大小
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a grinding disc with a blank rating label and a grinder with a blank rating label, greater-than symbol between them. No people.
shots.narration: 砂轮片额定转速要高于机器转速。

shots.scene: 耳塞图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pair of foam ear plugs next to loud sound waves. No people.
shots.narration: 噪声大时，戴好耳塞。

shots.scene: 护目镜加焊接面罩，护目镜加面屏两组图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icon pairs: safety goggles plus a welding helmet, and safety goggles plus a clear face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睛双重防护：护目镜再加面罩。

shots.scene: 欣欣把锯和夹具放在动火图标旁比较
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot compares a hand saw and a clamp with a flame icon, thinking.
shots.narration: 实验楼里，能不动火就不动火。

shots.scene: 冷切割、螺栓连接图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cold cutting tool and a bolted joint with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 能用冷加工、螺栓连接的，优先用。

shots.scene: 工件被搬到专用工作间
shots.prompt_en: A workpiece being carried to a dedicated workshop with a welding booth. No people.
shots.narration: 能拿到专用工作间做的，就别在楼里做。

shots.scene: 老李把空白申请单交给保卫处值班员
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hands a blank hot work application form to the security officer at a desk.
shots.narration: 校内动火，按规定提前申请审批。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员到现场查看，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The security officer inspects the cleared work spot with a blank checklist and ticks it.
shots.narration: 现场检查合格，才能开始作业。

shots.scene: 老李出示空白操作证
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer shows a blank work permit card.
shots.narration: 焊接切割是特种作业，必须持证。

shots.scene: 学生拿焊枪的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student hand holding a welding torch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 学生不得擅自动火。

shots.scene: 焊接点旁的排风罩把烟吸走
shots.prompt_en: A local exhaust hood next to a welding point drawing the fumes away. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接时开排风，把烟尘抽走。

shots.scene: 窗户打开、风扇图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an open window and an exhaust fan with airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 保持通风，戴好防尘口罩。

shots.scene: 狭小管道入口旁有禁止进入标志
shots.prompt_en: A narrow tank opening with a no entry sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 受限空间动火，有专门审批和检测。

shots.scene: 学生在入口前停步
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops in front of the narrow tank opening and steps back.
shots.narration: 学生不得进入受限空间。

shots.scene: 焊接结束，小研仍拿着灭火器观察现场
shots.prompt_en: Welding is finished; the female graduate student still watches the work spot holding a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 焊完不等于结束。

shots.scene: 缝隙里冒出细烟的图标，放大镜
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a thin wisp of smoke rising from a gap in the floor, with a magnifying glass over it. No people.
shots.narration: 火星可能藏在缝隙里慢慢阴燃。

shots.scene: 时钟图标和打勾的检查表
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon next to a blank checklist with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 继续观察一段时间，确认无火再离开。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿起灭火毯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot picks up a fire blanket with an urgent expression.
shots.narration: 万一起火，先停焊、断电。

shots.scene: 灭火器对着小火苗根部喷射的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fire extinguisher spraying at the base of a small flame. No people.
shots.narration: 初起小火，用灭火器或灭火毯扑灭。

shots.scene: 人群图标沿安全出口箭头撤离
shots.prompt_en: Person pictograms walking along an arrow toward an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 控制不住，立即撤离。

shots.scene: 电话图标和火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon next to a flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 拨打119，报告保卫处。

shots.scene: 报告链条图标：实验室—学院—保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons in a chain: a lab room, a department building and a security office. No people.
shots.narration: 同时报告负责人和学院。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现火焰和许可单图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a flame and a blank permit form.
shots.narration: 动火先想替代，必须动火先审批。

shots.scene: 移走、盖毯、清扫三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: boxes moved away, a cabinet under a fire blanket and a swept floor. No people.
shots.narration: 移走、盖严、扫净，现场先清理。

shots.scene: 面罩、手套、围裙、耳塞图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a welding helmet, leather gloves, a leather apron and ear plugs. No people.
shots.narration: 全套防护，助手也不例外。

shots.scene: 挡板、灭火器、看火人三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a flame resistant screen, a fire extinguisher and a person pictogram watching. No people.
shots.narration: 挡住火花，备好器材，专人看火。

shots.scene: 时钟和放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clock and a magnifying glass over a work spot. No people.
shots.narration: 完工后再查一遍余火。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的工作间挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in a tidy workshop next to a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 动火有章法，平安不出岔，下次见！
